full_page.content:
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
c. 1947
ST. FELIX FRIARY Route 8 HUNTINGTON, INDIANA.
Dear Mrs. Plunkett,
Thank you for your kind favor of July 19, received and duly recorded. May the good Lord always give you true interior joy.
God bless you,
Yes God bless you Grandma Plunkett. Keep young in heart and pray for us youngsters -- clear down to youngest great-grandchild.
Sincerely yours in Christ,
Fr. Solanus, O. F.M. Cap.
Note:
Above note typewritten by Fr. Solanus' secretary.
Added by Fr. Solanus in hand, "Yes God bless you
... yours in Christ" preceding his handwritten
signature.
Original in Possession of :
Miss Esther Plunkett
20505 Charleston
Detroit, Michigan 48203
